response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) with only brief, dated C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI in 2014-2015). He lacks demonstrated experience in the core requirements of this role: modern C++/STL architecture, message brokers, MQTT/REST for IoT, IEC 62443 security standards, and industrial protocols. His skills list doesn't even include C++.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated experience with networking, async I/O, and performance-oriented systems (DLang at Sociomantic)
Strong communication, mentoring, and documentation track record (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: No current or recent C++ experience — last significant C++ work was ~10 years ago and not at senior architectural scale
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No exposure to MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850/104, DNP3), or IoT platform architecture

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and architecture experience
